   **Pricing and paywall.**
      5 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: May 26, 2026 - Aug 5, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _R……………….._, Aug 5, 2026, 1/5: "Idiots cancelled my free trial for no reason"
            2. _pwsandcr_, Aug 2, 2026, 1/5: "Signed up to get into a gym, they’ve been draining a credit card I don’t use much of hundreds of pounds. My fault you may say and fair enough. But no easily findable cancel subscription bottom on the app, and for that 1* every time"
            3. _isidorast_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "they make your money off you not being able to cancel. I signed up for the free trial, forgot to cancel, and got charged. I tried to cancel and request a refund. not only did I not get a refund, I continued to be charged for months. and the bot in the app just tells you the same thing over and over again."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Mar 14, 2026 - Aug 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _MoRoNe93ahshsh_, Aug 6, 2026, 1/5: "The 14 day trial is just a straight up lie. As soon as you sign up for it you see that you can’t actually book anything with it- it even shows classes available to you specifically with the trial membership and when you try to book it says you have to upgrade. Also the app itself is soooo awful and buggy- nothing works."
            2. _BonemanJr3_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "Charge you for missing a class, mobile app constantly breaking, limited gyms, overpriced, buggy,"
            3. ___Mari__, Jul 19, 2026, 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
